summary: Tolgee is a self-hostable translation-management platform: Spring Boot + Kotlin + JPA backend managing organizations, projects, languages, translation keys, translations, machine-translation configs, content delivery, tasks, data import/export, notifications, webhooks, glossaries and translation memory across ~73 persisted entities in a PostgreSQL schema.

_no_edges.why: write-only internal interceptor (activity logging), no guards/needs - fires on any @ActivityLoggedEntity mutation
internal model utility seeded at project creation; no auth guard, no precondition, no downstream call
internal cleanup called from edit flows, no auth middleware, no pre-checks
internal signup helper creates own row from fresh signup; no guard
pure read+code check on reset_password_code keyed by username; only side effect is throwing; no row effect edge can be emitted beyond the wall absence recorded in no_guards
creates a brand-new org and becomes OWNER; no prior row-state wall (only userCanCreateOrganizations config + SSO exclusion)
self-scoped upsert of actor's own notification settings; no Permission/state wall (only blocks ACCOUNT_SECURITY group)
self-scoped image upload owned by actor; count limit guard, no Permission row wall
